title: Main board ANOVA_PRO_MAIN_V2.0 - LED / touch-key side
source: FCC ID 2APBOAN600, internal-photos exhibit 3999178 (2018 sample), page 3, top photo (720x537)

callouts.label: Touch key + LED: target temperature (thermometer icon)
callouts.part: metal spring/pad electrode with centre LED
callouts.note: Key-to-icon mapping derived by overlaying this board on the bezel photo (front_bezel). Verify on the device.

callouts.label: Touch key + LED: circle icon
callouts.part: metal pad electrode with centre LED
callouts.note: Circle icon on the bezel, function unconfirmed. The manual lists Current temp, Target temp, Timer, Start/Stop, +, -.

callouts.label: Touch key + LED: timer (clock icon)
callouts.part: metal pad electrode with centre LED

callouts.label: Touch key + LED: '+'
callouts.part: metal pad electrode with centre LED
callouts.note: + and - are symmetric icons, so which end is which comes from the mirror geometry only.

callouts.label: Touch key + 2 LEDs: start/stop (triangle icon)
callouts.part: metal pad electrode with two LEDs
callouts.note: The bezel back shows a left-pointing triangle, which is a right-pointing 'play' triangle from the front.

callouts.label: Touch key + LED: '-'
callouts.part: metal pad electrode with centre LED

callouts.label: 7-segment row 1 (4 digits, discrete LEDs)
callouts.part: SMD LEDs forming 4 digits; aligned with the thermometer key
callouts.note: Each segment is lit by discrete SMD LEDs behind the bezel light guide. Row order follows the bezel overlay. Refdes ranges are approximate.

callouts.label: 7-segment row 2 (4 digits)
callouts.part: SMD LEDs; aligned with the circle key

callouts.label: 7-segment row 3 (4 digits)
callouts.part: SMD LEDs; aligned with the timer key

callouts.label: Wi-Fi status LED
callouts.part: SMD LED behind the bezel's Wi-Fi icon window

callouts.label: Optical sensor (IR emitter + detector?)
callouts.note: Sits behind the rectangular bezel window. Likely proximity (wake on approach) or ambient-light sensing.

callouts.label: Tag-Connect style 6-pad debug footprint
callouts.part: TC2030-style: 2x3 pads + 3 alignment holes, R575 next to it
callouts.note: Back-to-back with J37 on the component side. Two footprints suggest one per MCU (CC3220S / CC2640R2F). Verify by continuity.

callouts.label: Antenna zone + 2 gold contact pins
callouts.part: copper-free zone without solder mask; 2 domed through-hole pins
callouts.note: The gold pins probably contact the black strip with a gold pad on the bezel (antenna element feed/ground?).

callouts.label: Antenna zone + 2 gold contact pins (J36)
callouts.part: copper-free zone; 2 domed pins; production label '1811601588'
callouts.note: Same pattern as #13, mates with the second black strip on the bezel. The label likely encodes the 2018 week-11 build date (unverified).
